fields.Name: T118 - AI Analytics Dashboard
fields.Description: Verifies the Analytics section of the AI app renders its dashboard widgets or a valid empty-state without crashing.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the AI application using the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT the Ctrl+K search box), then open the Analytics section. Confirm the analytics dashboard renders, showing KPIs, charts, or a valid empty-state with date-range controls. This is a platform view that may have sparse data in a fresh regression DB, so accept an empty-state as long as the dashboard chrome renders. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment, so wait for content rather than navigating away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The AI app Analytics section is displayed
The view shows analytics widgets (KPIs, charts, or date-range controls) or a clear empty-state
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
